mission.statement: Run a traceable Python-to-TypeScript project-editor proof of concept through paired Qdrant and FalkorDB memory arms.
mission.terminal_signal: A pinned Editor backend migration passes its preserved HTTP and upstream contracts in both arms, and evaluation reports every paired attempt with measured quality, latency, and resource use.

goals.title: Runnable container and CLI foundation
goals.rationale: All later stages need pinned tooling, persistent paths, and a stable command entry point.
goals.completion_signal: The image builds and the CLI responds inside the container.

goals.title: One-command shared ingestion
goals.rationale: Both arms must start from the same pinned source and cached evidence.
goals.completion_signal: A controlled fixture is ingested once, cached, and listed as ready in DuckDB.

goals.title: Isolated memory arms
goals.rationale: The independent variable is memory representation and retrieval under the same evidence budget.
goals.completion_signal: Both arms ingest the same snapshot and return provenance-bearing context within the same token budget.

goals.title: Paired migration workflow
goals.rationale: The shared workflow must produce and validate migrations in both language directions.
goals.completion_signal: Controlled Python-to-TypeScript and TypeScript-to-Python cases complete paired runs with behavioral checks.

goals.title: Traceable evaluation and external readiness
goals.rationale: Results need complete cost and failure accounting before testing the owner's repositories.
goals.completion_signal: Evaluate reports comparable pairs, flags incomplete runs, and preserves logs and generated artifacts.

goals.title: Prepare the Editor benchmark case
goals.rationale: The single proof of concept needs a pinned backend scope and executable contracts.
goals.completion_signal: Editor ingests at its pinned commit and its generated TypeScript API passes the preserved contracts.

goals.title: Run and evaluate paired Editor migrations
goals.rationale: A proof of concept requires comparable memory-conditioned runs with complete failure accounting.
goals.completion_signal: Repeated Editor pairs produce durable manifests and a report covering successes, failures, retrieval, latency, and tokens.

tasks.title: Package the Python CLI
tasks.rationale: Establish one command surface for the three strict stages.
tasks.acceptance_test: uv run deterministic --help lists ingest, migrate, evaluate
tasks.sdd_snippet: The CLI exposes ingest, migrate, and evaluate as separate stages.

tasks.title: Build the non-root runtime image
tasks.rationale: Provide reproducible Python and TypeScript tooling with writable runtime paths.
tasks.acceptance_test: docker build succeeds and the image runs deterministic --help as non-root
tasks.sdd_snippet: The Dockerfile pins tooling, creates /data/cache, /data/catalog, /data/runs, and excludes secrets and generated data.

tasks.title: Wire persistent local services
tasks.rationale: The CLI and both databases require stable volumes across rebuilds.
tasks.acceptance_test: docker compose config succeeds
tasks.sdd_snippet: Compose runs the CLI, Qdrant, and FalkorDB with persistent storage and runtime credentials.

tasks.title: Persist project and run catalog
tasks.rationale: Only ready snapshots should be selectable, and status must survive container recreation.
tasks.acceptance_test: A catalog entry persists and ready-only listing excludes incomplete ingestion
tasks.sdd_snippet: DuckDB at /data/catalog/projects.duckdb holds indexed snapshots and run transitions; the CLI is its sole writer. Project rows use strict versioned Pydantic validation on construction and read.

tasks.title: Load pinned repositories and fixtures
tasks.rationale: Every case needs a recorded immutable source revision.
tasks.acceptance_test: Ingest records a local fixture content revision and a pinned Git commit
tasks.sdd_snippet: The loader accepts repository URLs or local paths, records an exact revision, and filters source, manifests, and tests. Source snapshots and ingest inputs use Pydantic boundary models.

tasks.title: Extract and cache shared evidence
tasks.rationale: The arms must reuse identical parsed entities, summaries, and embeddings.
tasks.acceptance_test: Re-ingesting unchanged input yields the same evidence IDs and cache hits
tasks.sdd_snippet: Parse Python and TypeScript entities with provenance; cache summaries and embeddings by content and tooling versions.

tasks.title: Define the memory adapter
tasks.rationale: The workflow must use the same interface and evidence budget in both arms.
tasks.acceptance_test: Adapter contract checks IDs, provenance, budget, and persistence results
tasks.sdd_snippet: Agents use MemoryAdapter retrieve_context and persist_artifact without knowing the backing store. Adapter inputs and outputs use Pydantic models.

tasks.title: Implement Qdrant baseline
tasks.rationale: The vector arm must be a credible baseline with metadata and runtime feedback.
tasks.acceptance_test: An isolated collection retrieves and persists evidence and artifacts under the shared budget
tasks.sdd_snippet: Qdrant indexes the shared evidence and later artifacts with stable IDs and metadata filters.

tasks.title: Implement FalkorDB graph arm
tasks.rationale: The graph arm needs provenance-backed edges and bounded traversal.
tasks.acceptance_test: An isolated graph retrieves bounded linked evidence and persists task and validation nodes
tasks.sdd_snippet: FalkorDB stores the same base entities and substantiated directed relations, with one graph per run.

tasks.title: Build the shared migration state machine
tasks.rationale: Only the memory adapter may differ between paired runs.
tasks.acceptance_test: The same case launches both isolated arms with a common pair ID
tasks.sdd_snippet: Understanding, planning, building, and validation share one workflow and fixed retry cap.

tasks.title: Implement agent steps
tasks.rationale: Context packs, tasks, and migrated code must retain source evidence and run provenance.
tasks.acceptance_test: A controlled case produces a cited context pack, ordered tasks, and target code
tasks.sdd_snippet: Agents build cited Context Packs, ordered Migration Tasks, and generated target files via MemoryAdapter. Context Packs, tasks, and artifact metadata use Pydantic models.

tasks.title: Validate both controlled directions
tasks.rationale: Syntax alone cannot establish cross-language migration correctness.
tasks.acceptance_test: Both controlled directions compile and pass predefined executable behavioral tests
tasks.sdd_snippet: Validation checks compile/import/contracts and executable behavior, with bounded retries and failure feedback. Validation results use Pydantic models.

tasks.title: Record complete run telemetry
tasks.rationale: Costs, retrieval, failures, and artifacts must be auditable.
tasks.acceptance_test: Every run writes a manifest and valid JSONL with IDs, timings, tokens, costs, and validation events
tasks.sdd_snippet: Each run writes metrics.jsonl, code, validator output, run settings, and complete cost accounting. Run manifests and JSONL events use versioned Pydantic models.

tasks.title: Compare and report paired runs
tasks.rationale: Evaluation must distinguish valid pairs from missing or incomplete runs.
tasks.acceptance_test: Evaluate reports each completed run, paired deltas, and incomplete-run exclusions
tasks.sdd_snippet: Evaluate reads DuckDB, manifests, JSONL, validation, and artifacts; groups by revision and direction.

tasks.title: Enforce Ruff and boundary schema quality gates
tasks.rationale: Commits must pass lint, formatting, tests, and explicit validation rules before later components are added.
tasks.acceptance_test: uv run pre-commit run --all-files passes Ruff and pytest
tasks.sdd_snippet: Use Pydantic v2 for cross-stage and persisted records; pre-commit runs Ruff check, Ruff format, and pytest.

tasks.title: Validate shared evidence schemas
tasks.rationale: Parsed entities, relations, and summaries must be checked before either memory arm ingests them.
tasks.acceptance_test: Invalid persisted evidence is rejected before memory indexing
tasks.sdd_snippet: Entities, relations, and shared summaries use strict versioned Pydantic models at storage boundaries.

tasks.title: Validate benchmark scope and pinned commits
tasks.rationale: Validate benchmark scope and pinned commits so the pinned repositories can serve as honest benchmark cases.
tasks.acceptance_test: Both profiles reject stale commits or missing roots and exclude UI source from ingested evidence
tasks.sdd_snippet: The scope manifest names pinned commits, migration roots, contract roots, and preserved roots.

tasks.title: Plan only backend migration files
tasks.rationale: Plan only backend migration files so the pinned repositories can serve as honest benchmark cases.
tasks.acceptance_test: Planner emits no UI or contract-only migration task while retaining contract evidence for retrieval
tasks.sdd_snippet: The backend is migrated; preserved frontend and upstream paths remain read-only contract evidence.

tasks.title: Expose pinned Editor CLI runs
tasks.rationale: Make the selected Editor snapshot available to migrate by project ID.
tasks.acceptance_test: CLI selects pinned Editor and records its commit, backend sources, and Markdown API contract evidence.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Submodule revisions and selected paths are recorded in every benchmark run.

tasks.title: Build Editor executable contract harness
tasks.rationale: Use the pinned tests and upstream behavior as the scoring oracle.
tasks.acceptance_test: Generated service passes GET, PUT, 404, 409, 502, 504 and key-boundary HTTP cases.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Editor backend migrates; frontend and upstream remain in place as contract evidence.

tasks.title: Generate runnable Editor TypeScript backend
tasks.rationale: Create a target Node service from retrieved Python backend evidence.
tasks.acceptance_test: Editor output compiles and runs its HTTP contract harness.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Builder writes migrated code files for ordered tasks; validator checks import and behavior.

tasks.title: Make both memory arms retrieve runtime feedback
tasks.rationale: Index tasks, artifacts, and validation feedback in Qdrant and FalkorDB.
tasks.acceptance_test: Both live stores recover source evidence and runtime feedback under the same budget.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Both arms receive the same evidence and may differ only in representation and retrieval.

tasks.title: Condition the shared workflow on retrieved context
tasks.rationale: Use bounded memory context for understanding, planning, generation, and validation retries.
tasks.acceptance_test: A paired run records context IDs per task and bounded retry feedback.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Agents query MemoryAdapter for context and route validation feedback to bounded retries.

tasks.title: Persist run failures and stage telemetry
tasks.rationale: Create the run record before work, preserve terminal failures and measure stage costs.
tasks.acceptance_test: Injected failure still has a catalog row, manifest, error event, and output path.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Each migration run has status transitions, JSONL events, and a durable manifest.

tasks.title: Report all paired Editor outcomes
tasks.rationale: Include failed arms and quality, retrieval, token, and latency measures.
tasks.acceptance_test: Evaluation includes failed pairs and measured deltas without zero-cost claims.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Report behavioral success, context quality, token growth, retries, and end-to-end latency.

tasks.title: Execute repeatable Editor proof of concept
tasks.rationale: Run the pinned case in both isolated stores and document exact commands and limits.
tasks.acceptance_test: Live-model Editor pairs run with pinned summaries/embeddings and evaluate writes complete and failed outcomes.
tasks.sdd_snippet: One pinned repository is a feasibility proof; report model, versions, settings, and repeats.

tasks.title: Configure runtime model endpoint
tasks.rationale: Pass model settings into the non-root CLI without baking credentials into Docker.
tasks.acceptance_test: docker compose config succeeds and the image receives configured nonsecret model IDs.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Model credentials are supplied at runtime; cache, catalog, and run volumes persist.

tasks.title: Cache natural-language summaries and embeddings
tasks.rationale: Give both arms the same source summaries and model vectors with recorded preprocessing usage.
tasks.acceptance_test: Re-ingestion with the same model IDs hits the cache and returns identical Pydantic evidence.
tasks.sdd_snippet: Shared summaries and embeddings are cached by revision, parser, and model versions.
